correctness.rationale: For the published uniform-history resetting equation, the coherence factor f(t) solves f′=−(r+iω)f+(r/t)∫₀ᵗ f(u)du and is the Kummer {}_1F_1(iω/(r+iω);1;−(r+iω)t). Diagonals stay fixed, so the trace distance between |+> and |−> is |f|. At each of 786 rational rates q, the package CSV specifies early/late times and rational U<L; the associated standalone checker uses the 130-term Kummer series with all terms exactly rational real/imaginary, uniform tail R*<10^−30, and squared-modulus comparisons. Its interval radius (L−U)/(4(s+t)) follows the valid common/excess Poisson clock coupling bound |f_r(u)−f_q(u)|≤2u|r−q|. The 786 rational intervals cover [0.2,0.5] with min (L−U)/2>1/400; hence a continuum statement, not extrapolated sampled numerical points. Independently parsed all 786 source CSV rows and evaluated all 786 two-time Kummer differences via a separate 130-term floating series; zero violated local U/L inequalities; min raw safety margin approximately 7.22×10^−7, interval coverage reached 0.5000128088235, min half-gap=0.0025435. Independent high-precision samples at rates .2,.35,.499938 confirm actual increasing magnitudes. The full rational CSV verifier was inspected in source but not executed afresh; this distinction is retained.
